notifications.message: URGENT REROUTE ALERT: Insulin shipment SHP-882 (50,000 USD cold-chain cargo) diverted from N-5 due to multi-vehicle collision blocking all lanes near Hyderabad West Bypass. Ambient temp 42–44°C threatened spoilage. Now en route via M-9 Thatta Bypass with emergency cold-vault support. Revised ETA 52 minutes. Please prepare receiving dock. Driver contact: dispatch center.

URGENT: Blood Plasma shipment SHP-915 ($120,000, Ultra-Critical) rerouted due to Murree Road closure from severe storm. Severe winds (85 km/h), zero visibility, and flipped refrigerated truck have shut down the primary corridor. Shipment now rerouted to Srinagar Highway for 20-minute ETA (within 20-minute plasma integrity threshold). Truck is en route now. Contact BioRoute Emergency Line for updates.

URGENT BIOROUTE ALERT: Emergency reroute for SHP-915 (Blood Plasma, Ultra Critical, $120,000) due to complete closure of Murree Road corridor by severe storm.

HAZARD: Murree Road completely shut down. 85 km/h wind gusts, near-zero visibility, refrigerated truck flipped at Committee Chowk. Temperature currently 29°C, forecast to drop 8°C by nightfall.

SHIPMENT: SHP-915 rerouting immediately via Srinagar Highway to Holy Family Hospital.
- Original route: Murree Rd Islamabad → Rawalpindi
- New route: Srinagar Highway (20-minute ETA)
- Cargo: Blood Plasma (Ultra Critical) — 20-minute spoilage window at current temperature
- Status: Emergency Reroute
- Destination unchanged: Holy Family Hospital

CRITICAL: Blood plasma must remain below 35°C. Current ambient 29°C with downward trend. Ensure receiving bay is staffed and cold-chain handoff is ready upon arrival. Temperature-controlled truck en route now.

For real-time tracking or questions, contact dispatch emergency hotline immediately.

Stay safe.

URGENT ALERT: Shipment SHP-882 (Insulin, $50,000, Temperature Critical) has been emergency rerouted due to Port of Karachi strike delays.
